Do this in order:
1) Tap Choose sealed offer → Google Drive → EscapeHatchPhoneDrop → pairing-offer.json (wait for Offer loaded).
2) Type the 16-character code from PAIRING_CODE.txt in that same Drive folder (or PC Notepad).
3) Tap Confirm pairing.
Do not Confirm until step 1 says Offer loaded. LAN fetch is optional backup only.
EscapeHatch never pairs silently and never uploads your answers in plaintext.

2) Confirm the digest matches desktop.
3) Tap Save proof, then put escapehatch-phone-sync-proof.json back in that same Drive folder.
